summary.ko: 기존 계약과 호환성을 유지하는 작은 리팩터링 단위와 검증법을 만듭니다.
summary.en: Reduce code complexity through small changes that preserve behavior and compatibility.

required_inputs.description: Target code and its call sites or public contracts
Specific maintainability problem and allowed change scope

workflow.instruction: Document the behavior, public interfaces, persistence formats, and callers that must remain compatible.
Identify the concrete source of complexity and choose the smallest change that addresses it.
Add characterization checks where behavior is underspecified, then apply changes in reversible slices when edits are authorized.
Compare before and after behavior and report any intentional contract change separately for approval.

deliverables.name: Refactoring plan or patch
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Keeps changes scoped and preserves known interfaces

deliverables.name: Behavior checks
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Lists preserved contracts, verification results, and remaining uncertainty

limitations: Do not rewrite an entire subsystem merely to normalize style.
Uncovered behavior may require characterization before safe implementation.
permission_boundaries: Do not migrate production data, rename external APIs, or add dependencies as hidden refactoring steps.
Respect unrelated local changes and existing commit and push authorization.
